method: Exact expected forms are compared with each lemma's forms and rare_forms. The pilot is lemma-level only and has no tense/person annotation, so a different surface form cannot be attributed to the same person; no contradicted pair is inferred without that evidence. Missing expected forms are absent; missing lemmas are verb-not-in-pilot.
limitations: The pilot lacks tense/person tags; contradicted pairs require owner-verified same-person evidence and are therefore zero in this evidence-only report.
Passé composé is checked by participle form; auxiliary forms are generated from the immutable reference/paradigm.
